parts.problem_md:
**Complete **this sentence.

The layer used to display and format elements within a web page is called...
**State **two examples of CSS properties used to style text.
parts.solution_md:
Examples of CSS properties include:

Any **two **of the following:

- `font-size` **[1 mark]**
- `font-family` **[1 mark]**
- `color` **[1 mark]**
- `text-align` **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md: **State **two advantages of using an attached stylesheet in a webpage.
parts.solution_md:
Advantages of using an attached stylesheet include:

Any **two **of the following:

- Attached stylesheets can be edited separately from the HTML **[1 mark]**
- The same styles can be reused across multiple pages **[1 mark]**
- Helps keep HTML files cleaner and more organised **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
A stylesheet can contain styles and classes.

**Explain **the difference between a style and a class
parts.solution_md:
Differences include:

Any **two **of the following:

- A class definition name starts with a full stop **[1 mark]**
- A class is used for adding or changing a style within CSS **[1 mark]**
- Classes are subtypes within an element **[1 mark]**
- There are a limited number of styles **[1 mark]**
- Styles are pre-defined classes are user-defined **[1 mark]**
- Styles are defined in the head section **[1 mark]**
- Styles are used once but classes are styles saved for future use **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
Stylesheets are used in web pages.

**Explain **the differences between attached stylesheets and inline style attributes.
parts.solution_md:
The differences between attached and inline stylesheets are:

Any **four **of the following:

- Attached stylesheets are separate from the web page whereas Inline style attributes are within each web page **[1 mark]**
- An attached stylesheet is edited in one file whereas Inline style attributes are edited by changing each web page **[1 mark]**
- Attached stylesheet link has to go into the head section of the web page whereas Inline style attributes can be anywhere in the web page **[1 mark]**
- Inline style attributes can be within HTML tags **[1 mark]**
- Attached stylesheets can be applied to multiple pages whereas Inline style attributes only apply to individual web pages **[1 mark]**
- Inline style attributes can be used to override the attached stylesheet **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
Stylesheets are used in web pages.

**Explain **the term stylesheets when used in web pages.
parts.solution_md:
The term stylesheets is used in web pages when:

Any **two **of the following:

- Used to describe the presentation of a document written in HTML **[1 mark]**
- Enables the separation of presentation and content **[1 mark]**
- Part of the presentation layer **[1 mark]**
